$description: Design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the design system. Edit values here only -- do not hand-edit the generated src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.ts. The dev server regenerates them on every change (scripts/build-tokens.mjs, wired through vite.config.ts). Colors are authored as hex; the generator converts them to `H S% L%` channels for the web theme and keeps hex for mobile (tokens.ts). Every color role exists in both light and dark. Dark palette: the v2.0 Dark Command-Center Cockpit from docs/METRIX_DESIGN_BRIEF.html -- #050b18 ground, the brief's 7-level surface scale, #155dff electric blue primary and #16d9ff cyan intelligence accent, with Phase 3 §01's modifications on top (alpha-tint borders resolved to solids, ring raised to clear 3:1). The repo had drifted to the Nocturne v1 blurple; the brief is the reference it drifted from. Dark is the source-native mode (the IAP pins class=dark); light remains the earlier Command Deck derivative until a Nocturne light theme is designed. Status roles (success/warning/info/destructive) are a RESERVED palette: they never double as a chart series slot, so chart1-5 are free to change hue without repainting any state.

primary.$description: Signal blue (light-mode derivative of the deck's #38bdf8 accent-blue).

border.$description: Brief --border-soft rgba(86,140,255,.18) resolved to a solid — Phase 3 §01 replaces alpha-tint literals.

popover.$description: Brief surface-overlay, hsl(222 61% 7%) — popovers and dropdowns.

primary.$description: Brief --blue. The v2.0 electric-blue identity Phase 3 §01 keeps.

primaryForeground.$description: White-ish on the filled blue CTA.

secondary.$description: Brief surface-raised, hsl(219 55% 13%) — sub-panels and chips.

accent.$description: Brief --cyan. The intelligence accent — line and glow, never flood.

accentForeground.$description: Brief --bg-deep, for the rare filled-cyan case.

success.$description: Brief --success. Reserved status; never a chart series.

warning.$description: Brief --warning / --gold. Reserved status; never a chart series.

input.$description: Brief --border-soft resolved to a solid over the ground.

ring.$description: --mx-blue-400. 6.2:1 against the ground, closing the deferred Phase 5 item that left the ring at 2.8:1.

chart1.$description: Brief chart 1, electric blue, stepped into the dark lightness band.

chart2.$description: Brief chart 2, cyan, stepped into the dark lightness band.

chart3.$description: Violet. The brief puts gold here, but gold IS the warning token — a third series would be indistinguishable from a warning chip.

chart4.$description: Olive. The brief puts green here, which is the success token.

chart5.$description: Magenta. The brief puts red here, which is the danger token.

sans.$description: Body face. Figtree is a humanist geometric sans with a tall x-height, which is what keeps 14px readable at the density this product runs at.

mono.$description: Terminal readout face used for labels, metrics, and codes.

base.$description: Phase 3 §01 retunes the corner scale from 14px to 10px (sm 6 / md 8 / lg 10 / xl 14, modals keeping 14). The template derives sm = base - 4, md = base - 2, lg = base, xl = base + 4, so a 10px base lands every step on the spec: 6 / 8 / 10 / 14. Tighter corners read as instrument rather than consumer app, which is the brief's stated visual tone.
